jobs.description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for someone to own Runway's SEO and AEO strategy, end to end. You’ll build out our library of SEO content at scale, run experiments to sharpen what's working, own technical SEO health and report on what’s working to drive organic growth. This is a hybrid strategy-and-execution role. You won't just hand off a keyword list and wait. You'll be optimizing a piece of content one day and making a technical case to our development team the next. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own Runway's SEO and AEO strategy: Keyword cluster architecture (pillar-and-spoke), competitive SERP and content-gap analysis, understanding what stage of the buying journey a searcher is in so content matches what they actually need, as well as champion Runway's presence in AI-generated answers. - Build out Runway's library of SEO content: Briefs, landing pages, articles and more, identifying and scoping high-opportunity content, without sacrificing quality or brand voice - Design and run experiments on content formats, internal linking and page structure and use the results to sharpen the strategy - Own technical SEO health: Indexing, sitemaps, structured data and schema markup, ongoing site monitoring and recommend site structure and information architecture changes (page templates, internal linking, URL structure) that improve crawlability and rankings - Own measurement and reporting for organic growth: Track keyword rankings, organic traffic and AI citation trends against clear targets, and go beyond traffic volume to measure whether that traffic actually converts into product signups WHAT YOU'LL NEED - 4+ years in SEO, with experience contributing to overall strategy - Experience building or scaling an SEO function from a small base, moving fluidly between strategic and hands-on work - Experience collaborating across teams, including managing freelancers and partnering with product, marketing and design teams - Proficiency with GA4 and Google Search Console, plus keyword/competitive research tools like SEMrush or Ahrefs - Experience in AEO / AI-search visibility, with the ability to bake it into a broader SEO strategy - Experience using Profound, AirOps, or similar AEO tool is a plus - Experience at an AI, product-led or consumer-facing tech company is a plus, where SEO has to coexist with a fast-moving roadmap Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide. There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range. Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
고객센터에서 이관된 다양한 유형의 민원을 최종 응대하고 관리하는 HCE(Hard Customer Escalations) 민원 전문 조직입니다. 최종 민원 처리자로서 크리티컬한 이슈를 신속하게 해결하며, Issue Deep Dive를 통해 문제의 근본 원인을 파악하고 유관 부서로 정확하게 에스컬레이션합니다. 민원 데이터를 바탕으로 프로세스와 업무 환경을 주도적으로 개선하고, 복잡한 사례 대응 경험을 공유함으로써 CS 관리자의 역량 강화와 고객 경험 개선에 기여합니다.

Own the electrical architecture from the medium-voltage bus to the GPU rack — topology, redundancy, and standards — for halls scaling with AI compute load.

Direct Design, Commissioning, R&D, BIM/Designer, and Protection & Controls engineers on the Data Center team as those seats fill.

Ensure compliance with NFPA 70, 70B, 70E, NESC, and IEEE standards, prioritizing safety and engineering excellence.

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or another engineering discipline.
10+ years of electrical power design experience, with a focus on high-power, high-voltage or mission-critical systems.
Experience owning medium-voltage distribution architecture at 10 kV to 35 kV class.

Professional Engineering license or intention to actively seek a PE license.
5+ years in mission-critical, hyperscale, or heavy industrial facilities.
Experience with high-density AI compute and liquid-cooled deployments.
Experience delivering a repeatable design across multiple identical halls or phases.
Experience with power systems analysis software and tools: ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, PowerWorld, Matlab, PSCAD, PSEE, Simulink, etc.
Fluency in NEC, NFPA 70E, the IEEE 3000 series, and an internal reliability framework.
Experience building and leading an engineering team from the first hire.
Proven ability to lead teams, work independently, and thrive in dynamic, high-stress environments with tight deadlines.

Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.
Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support construction, energization, and operations.
Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.
Lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted.

Willing to work on-site in Memphis, TN. This is not a remote or hybrid role.

Valid driver's license.

jobs.description: Manager, Fixed Equipment Reliability The Manager, Fixed Equipment Reliability (FER Manager) is a technical second-line management and senior engineering position responsible for the refinery’s fixed equipment engineering, corrosion and materials engineering, and assigned reliability engineering functions. The FER Manager leads a multidisciplinary team and serves as the senior engineer and technical resource for the group, providing technical leadership, senior-level review, and strategic direction to improve safety, mechanical integrity, equipment availability, risk reduction, maintainability, and lifecycle cost performance across the refinery. The FER Manager recognizes and draws upon the specialized experience and expertise of individual team members while maintaining broad technical oversight of the group’s work. The FER Manager works across Operations, Maintenance, Inspection, Projects, Turnarounds, and company technical networks to establish fixed equipment strategies, develop long-range asset plans, manage corrosion and degradation risks, address chronic equipment issues, and support safe and reliable refinery operations. Safety and Process Safety Leadership Champion the refinery safety culture and ensure activities are conducted in accordance with company safety policies and procedures. Ensure fixed equipment engineering activities comply with applicable regulatory requirements, recognized and generally accepted good engineering practices (RAGAGEP), and company and refinery standards. Ensure appropriate technical support is provided for process safety events, incident investigations, and root cause failure analyses involving fixed equipment, corrosion, materials, and related reliability issues, participating directly when warranted. Leadership and People Management Lead and develop assigned fixed equipment engineering, corrosion and materials engineering, reliability engineering, and other technical personnel. Establish performance expectations and provide coaching, mentoring, technical guidance, senior-level technical review, and career development opportunities. Conduct performance reviews and succession-planning activities. Develop staffing strategies and participate in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and resource planning efforts, including use of contract technical support when appropriate. Ensure training and development plans are established and followed for team members. Mechanical Integrity and Asset Management Provide leadership for the refinery’s fixed equipment mechanical integrity and reliability programs, including pressure vessels, piping, tanks, heat exchangers, fired equipment, and other assigned fixed assets. Develop and execute strategies that improve equipment integrity and availability, manage degradation risk, reduce unplanned downtime and loss of containment potential, and optimize lifecycle cost. Provide engineering leadership for corrosion management, materials selection, damage-mechanism reviews, integrity operating windows, risk-based inspection, fitness-for-service evaluations, repair strategies, and remaining-life assessments. Use inspection findings, equipment condition, corrosion data, failure history, and risk information to prioritize improvements and communicate key indicators, trends, and concerns to business team stakeholders and refinery leadership. Govern fixed equipment criticality, lifecycle planning, obsolescence management, and long-term repair or replacement strategies. Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, and Inspection to improve equipment performance through effective operating practices, inspection plans, preventive maintenance, monitoring, and timely corrective action. Elevate significant or unresolved equipment risks, overdue actions, resource needs, and integrity concerns to refinery leadership when warranted. Technical Oversight Ensure the team proactively engages with Operations, Maintenance, and Inspection departments to identify, evaluate, and resolve emerging and recurring fixed equipment issues. Provide direct technical support and leadership for complex, high-risk, or cross-functional issues when warranted. Serve as a senior technical resource to the group by reviewing and challenging significant engineering evaluations, repair recommendations, risk assessments, and technical decisions, while appropriately leveraging subject-matter expertise within the team and company technical networks. Ensure appropriate engineering resources are provided to support equipment design, repair development, materials selection, welding and fabrication requirements, technical quality assurance, commissioning, and startup activities. Support Management of Change (MOC) activities and perform or assign senior technical reviews and technical approvals as required, with particular attention to complex, high-risk, or non-routine changes. Steward consistent application of applicable API and ASME codes, company and refinery standards, risk-based decision-making, fitness-for-service, failure analysis, and lifecycle cost analysis methodologies. Ensure significant technical work is appropriately reviewed based on complexity, risk, and the experience of the assigned engineer. Maintain clear technical interfaces among Fixed Equipment Engineering, Inspection, Operations, Maintenance, Projects, and Turnarounds, including ownership and timely closure of recommendations and action items. Turnarounds and Capital Projects Ensure integrity-driven work scopes and capital improvements are identified, developed, justified, and advanced through the appropriate refinery turnaround or capital-planning process. Ensure inspection findings, corrosion risks, repair requirements, maintainability, standardization, lifecycle cost, and long-term equipment needs are incorporated into turnaround scopes and capital projects. Ensure qualified technical resources support scope development, design reviews, repair plans, technical evaluations, execution, quality assurance, commissioning, startup, and post-startup performance verification, as applicable. Provide fixed equipment technical leadership for major outages and turnarounds, serving as the technical lead when appropriate. Business and Financial Management Develop and manage budgets for assigned fixed equipment engineering, corrosion and materials, and reliability activities. Prioritize engineering resources to align with refinery safety, mechanical integrity, operational risk, reliability, and business objectives. Develop multiyear forecasts for major repairs, lifecycle replacements, corrosion mitigation, reliability improvements, and risk-reduction initiatives. Track and report mechanical integrity and reliability performance indicators and the operational and financial value associated with improvement initiatives. Support refinery business planning through development of annual and multiyear fixed equipment asset improvement plans. Corporate and Industry Engagement Represent the refinery in applicable company fixed equipment, mechanical integrity, corrosion and materials, and reliability technical networks and ensure appropriate site participation and support. Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, applicable industry practices, regulatory requirements, and lessons learned relevant to fixed equipment integrity. Develop and maintain productive relationships with technical peers across the company and industry. JOB QUALIFICATION Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited institution. Minimum of 7 years of experience in fixed equipment, mechanical integrity, inspection, corrosion and materials, or related engineering work in refining, petrochemical processing, or a comparable industrial environment. Previous supervisory experience or a demonstrated record of successfully leading technical personnel and multidisciplinary work. Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Maintenance, Inspection, Engineering, Turnarounds, Capital Projects, and refinery leadership. Broad working knowledge of fixed equipment engineering, corrosion and materials, inspection, and reliability functions within a refinery or comparable operating facility, with the technical judgment to review significant work and support complex or high-risk issues. Demonstrated ability to manage a large and changing workload, establish priorities, and allocate resources based on safety, equipment risk, operational impact, and business value. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate technical risks, priorities, and recommendations. Demonstrated commitment to safety, personal integrity, accountability, and operational excellence. undefined Preferred Qualifications First- or second-line supervisory experience in a refinery or petrochemical facility. Advanced technical knowledge in at least one of the following areas: fixed equipment engineering, mechanical integrity, inspection, corrosion and materials, or equipment reliability. Working knowledge of applicable API, ASME, NBIC, company, and refinery engineering and inspection standards. Experience applying damage-mechanism reviews, corrosion control, risk-based inspection, integrity operating windows, fitness-for-service, root cause failure analysis, lifecycle cost analysis, and risk-based decision-making. Experience developing or managing fixed equipment inspection, monitoring, repair, and reliability strategies. Experience supporting turnaround planning and execution, capital-project development, fabrication and construction quality assurance, commissioning, and startup. Understanding of refinery business drivers and the relationship between mechanical integrity, process safety, unit availability, operating risk, and lifecycle cost. jobs.description: Are you passionate about managing the technical partnerships that connect automotive retailers to new ways of selling vehicles online? Amazon is revolutionizing the vehicle discovery and shopping experience, connecting customers with their ideal vehicle. As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will own the relationship with the dealer systems and third-party integrators that dealers depend on. Sitting at the intersection of Business Development, Engineering, and our integrator community, you are the trusted technical advisor and two-way translator — shaping the right integration paths for new partners, keeping integrators ahead of API changes, and driving our documentation toward true self-service. This role requires deep understanding of automotive dealer systems and independent judgment about what is operationally critical for a dealer. You must be technically fluent (able to read API specs, reason about data flows, and troubleshoot integrations), excel at navigating ambiguity, and thrive in an entrepreneurial, with excellent interpersonal skills. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the technical foundation of Amazon’s automotive business. Your insights from working directly with the integrator community will directly influence our APIs, documentation, and marketplace within the Automotive sector. Key job responsibilities 1. Partner with the BD team to assess prospective dealer and platform partners’ systems architecture and define the right integration path with Amazon's automotive business, bringing solutioning expertise into partner conversations. 2. Map dealer/DMS/platform capabilities to our APIs, surface constraints and dependencies early, and apply independent judgment on what is critical for dealer operations (inventory accuracy, transaction flows, data fidelity) to steer integration design. 3. Work closely with Engineering to understand upcoming API updates, deprecations, and new capabilities before they ship. 4. Proactively communicate API changes to the integrator community with enough lead time and clarity for them to plan and execute their own updates. 5. Act as the first line of technical support for integrators — answering questions, troubleshooting integration issues, and escalating to Engineering when needed. 6. Drive the accuracy and currency of API documentation by coordinating with the internal owners of each API surface. 7. Feed real integrator questions and friction points back into the documentation to continuously push it toward true self-service and reduce question volume at the source. 8. Build and manage durable relationships across BD, Engineering, documentation owners, and the external integrator ecosystem, operating with influence. A day in the life As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will work cross-functionally with Business Development, Engineering, and Product Management, while building and maintaining relationships with technical stakeholders across our external integrator and dealer-platform community. One part of your day may be spent advising BD on a prospective partner’s integration path; another translating an upcoming API change into clear guidance for integrators; another troubleshooting a live integration issue and feeding what you learn back into the documentation. You will be instrumental in defining how integrators build on Amazon's automotive business, providing valuable technical insights to product and engineering teams, and creating initiatives that scale integrator self-service. This role is based in London with occasional travel to meet with dealer platform partners and integrators. About the team This role explores opportunities to innovate in the automotive space. Our team aims to raise the bar on the car buying experience for end customers, while enabling industry partners and integrators to build and grow efficiently by leveraging Amazon’s capabilities.
